d:
"Chori Chori Dil Tera Churayenge" is from the 1993 Bollywood film "Phool Aur Angaar". The music for this song was composed by Anu Malik, and the lyrics were written by Rani Malik. It was sung by Kumar Sanu and Sujata Goswamy, both of whom brought their distinctive voices to this romantic duet.
